calls.statement:
SELECT 
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as web_net_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as order_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN fact_web_order o ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE s.store_id = 900
  AND d.calendar_date >= DATE '2025-11-03'
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY web_net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10;

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0), 2) as web_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN fact_web_order o ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE s.store_id = 900
  AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-11-03'
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY web_net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10;
